title: Fix DateTime Settings in Panel
instructions: The Panel class needs to load datetime configuration from panel.json and apply it when updating the time label. Currently, update_time() hardcodes "%H:%M" and ignores all settings like show_date, date_format, time_format, etc.

1784980707.912922.instruction: Add "xdgmenumaker" as a new option in the Type dropdown (QComboBox) in MenuConfigDialog. This type should hide the Leaf config group and Script config group since it generates menus dynamically from XDG .desktop files. Update on_type_changed() to handle this new type.

log.text: Added xdgmenumaker type to MenuConfigDialog: Added "xdgmenumaker" as 4th option in Type dropdown, created xdg_group with icon and terminal configuration fields, updated on_type_changed() to hide leaf_group and script_group for xdgmenumaker type, updated save_changes() to save xdgmenumaker config with type, icon and terminal fields, updated on_tree_item_clicked() to detect and load xdgmenumaker type from config.

Added xdgmenumaker support to menus_pyqt5.py: detects xdgmenumaker type in _scan_menu_directory(), generates menu from XDG .desktop files with _generate_xdg_menu() organized by categories, parses .desktop files with _parse_desktop_file(), launches apps with _launch_xdg_app() handling Terminal flag and field codes, _populate_menu() handles xdgmenumaker by generating dynamic XDG menu.

1785084320.3720214.instruction: Add code to load panel.json datetime configuration in Panel.__init__. Store it as self.datetime_config with defaults for all settings (show_time, time_format, show_seconds, show_date, date_format, etc.).

log.text: Added datetime config loading in Panel.__init__ with _load_datetime_config() method that reads from panel.json with defaults for all settings.

Task completed: Panel.__init__ loads datetime configuration from panel.json via _load_datetime_config() method. Configuration stored in self.datetime_config with defaults for all settings: show_time=True, time_format='24h', show_seconds=False, show_date=False, date_format='%Y-%m-%d', update_interval=1000, timezone='local', font_family='Arial', font_size=10, bold=True, color='#ffffff'.

1785084324.1829045.instruction: Modify Panel.update_time() to use self.datetime_config settings. Build the display string based on show_time, time_format, show_seconds, show_date, and date_format settings. Combine time and date appropriately with a space separator.

log.text: Rewrote Panel.update_time() to use datetime_config settings - now builds display string based on show_time, time_format, show_seconds, show_date, and date_format settings. Time and date are combined with space separator.

Task completed: Panel.update_time() now uses self.datetime_config settings. It builds the display string by checking show_time (with time_format and show_seconds), then show_date (with date_format), and combines them with space separator. Time format supports both 12h (%I:%M %p) and 24h (%H:%M) with optional seconds.

1785084328.1785846.instruction: Add a signal or callback mechanism so that when DateTimeConfigDialog saves changes, the Panel reloads the datetime configuration and updates the time display. This should work similar to how MenuConfigDialog's menus_changed signal works.

log.text: Added datetime config reload mechanism: Panel has datetime_changed signal and reload_datetime_config() method that reloads config, updates timer interval, updates font/color, and forces update. DateTimeConfigDialog emits config_saved signal when saving. Panel.open_datetime_config() connects dialog.config_saved to reload_datetime_config.

Task completed: Added signal mechanism for datetime settings reload. Panel has datetime_changed=pyqtSignal() and reload_datetime_config() method that reloads config, updates timer interval, font, color, and forces update. DateTimeConfigDialog has config_saved=pyqtSignal() emitted in save_and_close(). Panel.open_datetime_config() connects dialog.config_saved to reload_datetime_config, enabling live updates when settings are saved.
